spec.moment: Reaching the summit of Mission Peak at sunrise with dad beside the iconic pole.

elements.name: Trail summit

spec.scene: A steep grassy hilltop is bathed in warm peach-colored sunrise light. In the center stands a weathered metal pole with viewing holes, casting a long shadow across the golden-green grass and gravel. Beside it, a man in a navy fleece and grey cap rests on a walking stick, while a hiker in an ochre jacket takes in the view. Along the back edge, a small black-and-white cow grazes on a lower fold of the ridge.
spec.title: Summit at Sunrise
spec.caption: Reached the peak with Dad just as the sun broke through.
